text.value: Why it is $495.00

text.label: Text: title
text.value: It is $495.00 because it is worth $50,000.00.

text.label: Text: That is what clients pay us to build it
text.value: That is what clients pay us to build it for them. They pay it because you build this once and you use it for the rest of your life. Your website, your list, your systems: they keep working long after the build is paid for.

text.label: Text: paragraph 2
text.value: The book is that same build, in the order we do it, in plain words. Do it yourself, or hand the book to somebody you pay and have them follow it.

text.label: Text: paragraph 3
text.value: Most people who read it will still want it built for them. That is fine. Either way you will know exactly what you are getting and why.

text.label: Text: eyebrow
text.value: Why you buy it here

text.label: Text: title
text.value: You will not find this book on Amazon. That is the point.

text.label: Text: paragraph 1
text.value: A store would cap what we can charge for it at $200.00, keep most of that, and keep your name. So we sell it on the website we own, and the only thing we rent is the card processor.

text.label: Text: paragraph 2
text.value: Musicians and actors have been handing most of their money to the company in the middle for as long as there has been a middle. Social media was never free either: the advertising paid for it, and you were what was sold.

text.label: Text: paragraph 3
text.value: This book shows you how to turn that around. Use the free platforms on purpose, and send the attention to the place you own.
